pairs.english: The real river lay beyond the railing, bending down from the upper sluice with a sheen of wrinkles.

pairs.target: zhè shì tāmen zài cǎopō shàng quān hǎo de rìzi .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi míngtiān cái huí huī ào .

pairs.target: " liáng nàme zhǔn zuò shénme ? yòu bù zǎi wǒ . "

pairs.hanzi: “量那么准做什么？又不载我。”

pairs.hanzi: 他换了三个名字，最后选了“追不上”。

pairs.english: Tavi asked who couldn't catch up; Iven said they'd decide after launching.

pairs.target: yígòng sāngè rén chuī fān .
pairs.english: Three of them blew the sails.
pairs.hanzi: 一共三个人吹帆。

pairs.english: Iven said nothing. He simply lifted “Can't Catch Up” and solemnly shook two drops from its hull.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有说话。他只是把“追不上”捞起来，郑重地晃掉船舱里的两滴水。

pairs.target: mǐlā qiǎng guòzhǎi chuán , zài dǐxià tiē le diǎn shī ní , yòu bǐ yícì .
pairs.english: Mira grabbed her narrow boat, stuck wet mud underneath, and raced again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抢过窄船，在底下贴了点湿泥，又比一次。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā yíng le , sū yǐ què zhǐzhe fān , shuō gāngcái tǎ wéi bǎ qì quán chuī dào zhè yìbiān le .
pairs.english: She won this time, but Suyi pointed at the sail and said Tavi had blown all his breath that way.

pairs.target: wán dào tānzhǔ cuī tāmen ràng dìfāng shí , tàiyáng yǐjīng yí guò tóudǐng .

pairs.english: Mira left the reshaped wood; wiping his knife, the seller suddenly asked her what the mud underneath was for.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉留下改过的木片，摊主把小刀擦净，忽然问她底下那点泥是干什么的。

pairs.target: tāmen zài mài suān guǒ shuǐ de péng xià děng língqián , yízhèn chuán làng pāi shàng táijiē .
pairs.english: While they waited for change beneath the sour-fruit-water stall's awning, a boat's wake struck the steps.

pairs.target: pángbiān xì zhe de xiǎo huò zhōu tái le táitóu , guà zài cāngkǒu de dēng yě gēnzhe huàng ,

pairs.target: dēng lǐ de yóuzhǎn què zhī qīng le yìdiǎn , hěnkuài yòu zhèng guòlái .
pairs.english: but the oil cup inside tilted only slightly and soon righted itself.
pairs.hanzi: 灯里的油盏却只倾了一点，很快又正过来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng le jiē bēizi .

pairs.hanzi: “想看灯。”

pairs.english: he still couldn't swim, but admitting it no longer made his face burn.
pairs.hanzi: 他还没有会游泳，只是不再因为承认这件事而脸热。

pairs.target: yīwén yě méi quàn , bǎ bēizi wǎng lángān lǐmiàn nuó , gěi tā ràngchū yìdiǎn zhànwěn de dìfāng .

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu pèng dēng , zhī wèn néng bunéng huà .

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zìjǐ de kōng bēi dǎokòu , yāzhù zhǐ jiǎo .

pairs.hanzi: 伊文把自己的空杯倒扣，压住纸角。

pairs.target: " zhè néng tí zhe zǒu ma ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Can you carry this while walking?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “这能提着走吗？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " néng . bùnéng ná tā fāngēntou . yóu zhuāngmǎn le , yíyàng sǎ . "
pairs.english: “Yes. You can't tumble with it. Fill it with oil to the brim and it'll still spill.”
pairs.hanzi: “能。不能拿它翻跟头。油装满了，一样洒。”

alignment.english: Fill it with oil to the brim

pairs.target: chuánzhǔ bǎ liǎngdào huán fēnbié zhuǎngěi tā kàn , yòu zhǐ le zhǐ mósǔn de zhóukǒng .
pairs.english: The owner turned each ring for him, then pointed to the worn pivot holes.
pairs.hanzi: 船主把两道环分别转给他看，又指了指磨损的轴孔。

pairs.target: dēng shì línjū zuò de , bǔguò liǎnghuí , búshì shénme yǒngyuǎn búyòng guǎn de hǎo dōngxī .
pairs.english: A neighbour had made the lamp, and it had been repaired twice; it wasn't something that never needed care.
pairs.hanzi: 灯是邻居做的，补过两回，不是什么永远不用管的好东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lián nà chù mósǔn yě huà le jìnqù .
pairs.english: Tavi drew the wear too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维连那处磨损也画了进去。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé sū yǐ gǎnlái shí , tā de suān guǒ shuǐ yǐjīng bù liáng le .
pairs.english: By the time Mira and Suyi arrived, his fruit drink was no longer cool.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡赶来时，他的酸果水已经不凉了。

pairs.target: mǐlā yí kàn zhǐ jiù zhīdào tā zài xiǎng shénme , què xiān wèn shìbushì yào sòng rén .

pairs.hanzi: 米拉一看纸就知道他在想什么，却先问是不是要送人。

pairs.target: tā shuō ā duō yǐqián wèn guò , xiànzài xiǎng dài zhāng xiàngyàng de tú huíqù .
pairs.english: He said Ado had asked before, and now he wanted to take a decent drawing home.
pairs.hanzi: 他说阿多以前问过，现在想带张像样的图回去。

pairs.target: " huà shàng chǐcùn . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Add dimensions,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “画上尺寸。”她说。

pairs.target: yīwén ná qǐ nàtiáo xiǎo kuān chuán , bǎ tā yā zài zhǐbiān : " nǐ gāngcái hái méi chǐ ne . "
pairs.english: Iven picked up his wide little boat and weighed down the paper. “You didn't have a ruler earlier.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文拿起那条小宽船，把它压在纸边：“你刚才还没尺呢。”

pairs.target: mǐlā dèng tā . tā gǎnjǐn jǔqǐ bēizi , jiǎzhuāng méiyǒu shuō guò .
pairs.english: Mira glared at him. He hastily raised his cup and pretended he'd said nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉瞪他。他赶紧举起杯子，假装没有说过。

pairs.target: huíchéng shí , tǎ wéi de túzhǐ zhān le yìdiǎn guǒ shuǐ , liǎnggè huán nián zài yìqǐ .

pairs.target: tā xiǎoxīn bǎ zhǐ fēnkāi , hūrán juéde míngtiān huíjiā , búbì zhǐyǒu yìfēng wèn jiùshì de xìn kě jiǎng .
pairs.english: He carefully separated the paper, suddenly feeling that tomorrow's homecoming needn't mean only a letter asking about the past.
pairs.hanzi: 他小心把纸分开，忽然觉得明天回家，不必只有一封问旧事的信可讲。

pairs.target: hémiànshàng de nàzhǎn méi diǎnliàng de dēng , yě néng jiǎng hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: That unlit lamp on the river could fill a long conversation too.
pairs.hanzi: 河面上的那盏没点亮的灯，也能讲很久。
